summary: The proposed patch addresses an issue with VLAs but may not cover all edge cases related to variable-length arrays.

issues.description: The patch only addresses columns with format 'P' or 'Q'. There might be other formats or scenarios involving VLAs that are not covered, leading to potential functional incompleteness.
There are no additional tests provided to verify the fix for different types of VLAs or other edge cases. More comprehensive tests are needed to ensure the robustness of the solution.
